# Northside Plumbing

> Northside Plumbing is a licensed plumbing company serving homes and small businesses in Springfield and the surrounding area. We fix leaks, clear drains, install and repair water heaters, and offer same-day emergency callouts.

- Service area: Springfield, Riverside and Oak Hill.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am to 7pm. Emergency callouts 24/7.
- Contact: call (555) 010-0199 or book online at https://northside-plumbing.example/book
- We do not do new-build plumbing or gas lines.

## Services

- [Leak repair](https://northside-plumbing.example/services/leaks): Finding and fixing leaks in pipes, taps and toilets
- [Drain cleaning](https://northside-plumbing.example/services/drains): Blocked sinks, showers and main drains
- [Water heaters](https://northside-plumbing.example/services/water-heaters): Repair and replacement of tank and tankless heaters
- [Emergency plumbing](https://northside-plumbing.example/emergency): 24/7 callouts, what counts as an emergency, and call-out fees
